label_assignment: Architectural label is design-level; directional/project/model labels require future evidence and may accompany it; no empirical label assigned now

labels.CONTINUITY_ARCHITECTURAL: Same CODE/PROCESS/TEXT definitions and late-fusion hierarchy documented; distinct reconstructed/historical states and populations disclosed
labels.CONTINUITY_DIRECTIONAL: Architectural continuity plus exact same-row/state/probability linkage, passing E1/E2 fidelity and stable within-scale directional co-occurrence; descriptive only
labels.CONTINUITY_MODEL_DEPENDENT: Directional conditions vary by family within an aligned project/population; all families shown
labels.CONTINUITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED: Architecture/semantics incompatible or required empirical linkage absent for the proposed claim
labels.CONTINUITY_PROJECT_SPECIFIC: Directional conditions hold only in named projects; disclose all other projects and failures

class_definitions.ARCHITECTURAL: Same frozen modality semantics and late-fusion architecture; distinct study rows/models labelled explicitly
class_definitions.CONCEPTUAL_ONLY: Same modality/family concepts without an exact or validated architectural empirical chain
class_definitions.DIRECT: Same exact local chain and quantities, complete proof
class_definitions.NESTED: Global only, proved nested population with common linked states, adequate coverage and no subset bias
class_definitions.NONE: Material mismatch or missing even conceptual linkage

parent_exact_link_contract.composite_figure: Show linked E1 and E2 panels with explicit scales and baseline definitions; arrows denote provenance, not equality of additive feature bars to fusion-logit bars. No toy numeric examples are results.

cross_level_scale_bridge.boosted_trees: Objective-governed raw margin -> exact positive-class link -> beta_m*(p_m-mu_m)
cross_level_scale_bridge.warning: E1 logit/margin feature attributions cannot be multiplied by beta or summed as the E2 modality attribution without a separately justified compositional method. Nonlinear probability links change the quantity. E1 intercept/feature baseline and E2 OOF baseline differ.

global_requirements: stable direction supported by actual future evidence

parent_exact_link_contract.same_predictor_rule: Local DIRECT requires the exact predictor identity, never merely a scientifically linked replacement. Global nested claims require separately proved nesting and state/output linkage.
